reviews.text: Viorica was very kind to my dog, very attentive and careful, gave me very useful suggestions and was an excellent professional! I really liked her and my dog ​​did too! :)

I called without knowing them beforehand, based only on the good feedback I'd read, and I couldn't be happier! I explained that I had adopted a dog less than 24 hours prior and that he urgently needed a haircut due to the state of his coat. The kindness and attention were immediate. As soon as there was a cancellation, they called me right away to reschedule and even sent a reminder the day before. The final result was incredible 😍 (see the before and after photos!). I recommend them 100% and they've gained a loyal customer. Thank you so much for your kindness! 🥰🐾 5-star service and top-notch professionalism 🔝

We love this Anjos Patudos, and it has been such a positive experience working with Viorica!

We recently adopted a dog who had not been able to be properly groomed for longer than ideal. She was covered in difficult tangles and is generally very anxious, sensitive, and challenging to groom.

We were quite nervous about bringing her in, but we are so glad we found Viorica. In addition to being difficult to groom, our dog also has allergies that require extra care. She was very accommodating of all our needs, and our pup left the experience seeming calm and happy.
I'm very happy with my dog's bath. Thank you for the excellent service!

I couldn’t be happier with the cut Verónica did for my dog, Xica.

It’s immediately clear that Verónica is not a beginner groomer. The attention to detail was outstanding. Not only did she carefully keep the parts of the coat I asked her to preserve, but the overall symmetry and finish were excellent.

What impressed me the most, though, went far beyond the haircut itself. Verónica took a great deal of time to listen to my concerns and to understand my dog’s specific needs. Xica is a 12-year-old dachshund with a painful leg, and her well-being was clearly the top priority throughout the entire session. Verónica worked slowly, gently, and patiently, always making sure Xica felt safe and comfortable, even if that meant putting a “perfect” cut second to her welfare.

The session lasted over two hours, which speaks volumes about the level of care, attention, and respect she gives to the animals she works with. You can really feel that she values the dog’s experience just as much as the final result.

I wholeheartedly recommend Verónica to anyone looking for a groomer who combines technical skill, patience, and genuine care for animals. We will absolutely be back.
